rules.scoring: Work in integer hundredths: h(x) = round(100*x) of a proj or floor as the file carries it (2 decimals). starters(roster): candidates are the roster's players with ir false, ordered by proj descending, then seen descending, then name ascending. For each position in lineup.slots, take the first n unused candidates of that position. Then for each entry of lineup.flex in order, take the first n unused candidates whose pos is in the entry's pos list. A slot is worth max(h(proj), bar), where bar is h(lineup.floor[pos]) for a fixed slot and the largest h(lineup.floor[p]) over the entry's pos list for a flex slot. A slot with no candidate left is worth bar. lineup(roster) is the sum of the slot values, and a floored starter still counts as a starter. gain = tenths(lineup(R3) - lineup(R1)) where R1 is the owner's values list, R3 is R1 minus send plus get (get players are taken from the partner's values list, matched by name, keeping their ir flag) minus ir_moves minus drop, and tenths(d) is d/10 rounded half away from zero, divided by 10, so one decimal. The search keeps only offers with gain >= rules.min_gain before the moves and drops. Players moved to IR or dropped never start, so they do not move gain.
rules.drop: R2 = the owner's values list minus send plus get (get players from the partner's values list, matched by name, each with its own ir, ir_ok, keep and protect). irs = the players of R2 with ir true. count = the players of R2 with ir false, plus other[owner]. over = count - lineup.cap. When over <= 0, ir_moves and drop are []. Otherwise: (1) IR first. free = max(lineup.ir - irs, 0). Candidates are the players of R2 with ir false and ir_ok true, get players included, ordered by keep descending, then seen descending (as published, 1 decimal), then name ascending. ir_moves = the first min(free, over) candidates, in that order; from here a moved player counts as ir true: he never starts and no longer counts toward the cap. over = over - len(ir_moves). (2) Drops. When over > 0: L = the players of R2 with ir false that are not in ir_moves. stay = starters(L) plus the get players. pool = the players of L not in stay and with protect false, ordered by keep ascending, then seen ascending (1 decimal), then name ascending. drop = the first `over` of the pool, in that order. When the pool holds fewer than `over` players the offer is not written. Players with protect true are never released (protect is in values: an early draft pick, or a player whose keep would start for at least half the other teams at his position). K and D/ST (other) are never released or moved. Only the owner's room is checked, never the partner's.
rules.views: An offer is written only when three views of the owner's lineup agree. proj: gain >= rules.min_gain (the offer's gain). work: every player on both rosters and the wire valued by the points his work is worth (role_board xfp_g plus last season's gap, ESPN-scaled; proj where there is no row), gain > 0. pace: every player and the wire valued by his 2026 points per game in the league's scoring (proj where he has no game), gain > 0. Each view uses the same lineup rule, with its own floor: the best of the same available free agents valued in that view. A player whose proj is 0 is 0 in every view. Bold and fair keep their partner tests; offers are ranked by gain. Not in values: a reader cannot re-derive work or pace.
rules.floor: lineup.floor[pos] is the best proj among the league's free-agent file rows that are healthy, on no roster in that league's roster file, not on waivers (ESPN's waiver flag, the Yahoo leagues' status=W list) and not Out or IR; 0 when none is left.
